summary: A sound toggle with volume, a profile picker (system, glass, brutalism, terminal) and a board of buttons that each play one cue.
use: Let people audition a sound profile before turning interface sound on in an app.
spec: `<SoundToggle volume />` next to a `SegmentedControl` bound to the profile
`$effect(() => sound.use(PROFILES[profile]))` pins the picked profile and `onDestroy` releases it
A `role="group"` board of outlined small `Button` items, each with `sound={cue}` for one cue name
